content: Amenɣi ḍidd i ujeǧid Yabin d ijeǧiden nni akis iǧan
Umi Yabin, ajeǧid n Ḥaṣur, isřa aya, issekk ɣar Yubab, ajeǧid n Madun, ɣar ujeǧid n Cimrun, ɣar ujeǧid n Akcaf,
u ɣar ijeǧiden inni tuɣa izeddɣen ɣar ccamal di Temmurt n Idurar u di Řewḍa ɣar ljanub zi Kinnarut u di Temmurt Iwaṭan u x tiwririn n Dur ɣar řɣarb,
ɣar ayt n Kenɛan di ccarq d řɣarb, Imuriyyen, Iḥittiyyen, Ifiriziyyen, Iyabusiyyen deg idurar d Iḥiwiyyen ɣar uḍar n wedrar n Hirmun, di temmurt n Miṣfa.
Ffɣen-dd nitni s marra řɛeskar nsen akidsen, ijj n ubarra ameqqran n řgens, am yijdi ɣar tma n řebḥar, anect aṭṭas, uca arni ɣares aṭṭas s waṭṭas n iysan d ikarruten.
Marra ijeǧiden-a řaɣan-dd xasen uca usin-dd, wtin iqiḍan nsen jmiɛ ɣar waman n Mayrum i umenɣi ḍidd i Israil.*

Inna SIDI i Yacuwa: “War zzaysen tteggʷed, minzi tiwecca ɣar řweqt ammu řexxu ad ten ggeɣ ttwaɣeřben marra zzat i wudem n Israil. Cek ad tqessed iẓewran n iḍaren n iysan nsen uca ad tesscemḍed ikarruten nsen di tmessi.”
Yacuwa s marra řɛeskar akides, iffeɣ-dd ɣarsen s ict n řɣefřet ɣar waman n Mayrum uca wḍan-dd xasen.

SIDI igga i-ten deg ufus n Israil uca nitni wtin ten, ḍfaren ten ař Ṣidun-Ameqqran d Misrafut-Mayim, u ař taysart n Miṣfa ɣar ccarq. Nitni qḍan ten ařami war zzaysen jjin ad iqqim uřa d ijj n umarweř.
Yacuwa igga akidsen am mammec d as inna SIDI. Netta iqess iẓewran n iḍaren n iysan nsen uca issecmeḍ ikarruten nsen s tmessi.
Di řweqt nni iɛqeb Yacuwa uca iṭṭef Ḥaṣur uca iwta ajeǧid nnes s řeqḍeɛ n ssif, minzi Ḥaṣur tuɣa-t qbeř d azeǧif x marra tigeldiwin-a.
Wtin marra řeɛmar iddaren nni dayes iǧan s řeqḍeɛ n ssif uca ḥarrmen ten u nɣin ten. War iqqim walu zi marra min ittarran nnefs uca issecmeḍ Ḥaṣur s tmessi.
Iṭṭef Yacuwa marra tineddam n ijeǧiden-a s marra ijeǧiden nsen uca iwta i-ten s řeqḍeɛ n ssif uca iḥarrem i-ten, am mammec tuɣa yumur Musa, amsexxar n SIDI.
Marra tineddam nni ibedden x tiwririn war tent sscemḍen Israiliyyen s tmessi, mɣir Ḥaṣur umi issecmeḍ Yacuwa s tmessi.
Keccḍen ayt n Israil marra takeccaḍt n tneddam d řebhayem i ixef nsen. Maca nitni nɣin marra iwdan s řeqḍeɛ n ssif, ařami ten teḥḥan. Marra min ittaran nnefs, war zzayes jjin uřa d ijj.
Lista n marra min iṭṭef Yacuwa n temmurt n Kenɛan
Am mammec t yumur SIDI i umsexxar nnes Musa, ammu i t igga Musa x Yacuwa, uca ammu i-t igga Yacuwa. Netta war ismiḥ uřa deg ijj n wawař zi marra awařen i yumur SIDI i Musa maḥend ad t igg.
Ammu iṭṭef Yacuwa marra tammurt nni: Tammurt n Idurar d marra Tammurt n Ljanub d marra tammurt n Jucan d Temmurt Iwaṭan d Řewḍa d idurar n Israil d řwaṭa nnes,
marra tammurt zeg Wedrar d Aqeccar, wenni isgeɛɛaden ɣar Saɛir ař Baɛl-Jad, di teysart n Lubnan, swadday i wedrar n Ḥirmun. Marra ijeǧiden nsen iḥebbes i-ten, iwta i-ten uca inɣa i-ten.
Aṭṭas n wussan i immneɣ Yacuwa ak-d marra ijeǧiden-a.
War iǧi uřa d ict n tendint i iggin řehna ak-d ayt n Israil, mɣir Iḥiwiyyen, inni tuɣa izeddɣen di Jibɛun. Nitni ṭṭfen tent marra s umenɣi.
Minzi SIDI tuɣa igga ad isseqseḥ uř nsen ař dd ɣa ffɣen ad mmenɣen ak-d Israil, ḥima ad ten iḥarrem uca war xasen yareḥḥem, ḥima ad ten iqḍa, am mammec tuɣa yumur SIDI i Musa.

Di řweqt nni iffeɣ Yacuwa uca iteḥḥa Iɛanaqiyyen zi temmurt n idurar, zi Ḥabrun, zi Dabir, zi Ɛanab, zi marra Tammurt n Idurar n Yahuda u zi marra tammurt n idurar n Israil. Yacuwa iḥarrem i-ten ak-d tneddam nsen i uteḥḥi.
Di temmurt n ayt Israil war qqimen ɛad Iɛanaqiyyen. Qqimen mɣir di Ɣazza, Jat d Acdud.
Iṭṭef Yacuwa marra tammurt nni, am mammec marra i tuɣa issiweř SIDI ɣar Musa, uca Yacuwa iwca i-tt d řwart i Israil ɛlaḥsab tirbiɛin n tqebbař nsen. Xenni tuɣa tammurt tareyyeḥ zeg umenɣi.
